              "consumes_outcome_from": "7:1",

                "server room tower",
                "glowing beacon",
                "digital horizon",
                "wireframe plains"

                "wireframe clouds",
                "sheer drop",

                "static campfire",

                "blue light projection",
                "grim faces"

                "delete admin prompt",
                "floating UI panel"

                "delete admin prompt",
                "floating UI panel"

              "outcome": "End of Book 1.",
